text: So bootless to run towards a fading sun
Just cave to your reaper’s touch
Come back to the warmth of the infinite dark
Where we’ll never grow apart
Oh
Pushing daisies
I shall take thee
Pushing daisies
Like you’ve always dreamed
From rest and sleep, which but thy pictures be
Much pleasure; then from thee much more must flow
One short sleep past, we wake eternally
And death shall be no more
O death, thou shalt die
Bid farewell to the pains that you could not shake
Let me wash them all away
With just another taste you will feel no weight
So cave to our sweet embrace
Oh
Pushing daisies
I shall take thee
Pushing daisies
Like you’ve always dreamed
And soonest our best men with thee do go
Rest of their bones, and soul’s delivery
One short sleep past, we wake eternally
And death shall be no more
O death, thou shalt die
